findings.location: Implementation Design ID-R01, ID-I01 and ID-T01; trusted issuance contract
findings.affected_requirement: Story 18.1 direct production-capability acceptance; spec FR-001 and SC-005; tasks T003-T004
findings.evidence: At the reviewed checkpoint, the plan requires tests to call a trusted production issuer, but specifies only the read-context interface after issuance. The contract likewise describes issuance without a callable issuer interface or typed success/failure result. T004 names PreparedSourceContextIssuer while T003 requires public-seam RED tests for missing verifier and absent approval. The completed T002 Core contracts contain a grant request, verifier and read context, but no issuer call. T003's test author would have to invent the public call and its failure shape, a consequential interface decision that should be fixed before behavioral RED.
findings.correction_outcome: Define the smallest callable trusted issuer seam and its observable issuance result: required verifier dependency, grant-request input, success/context invariant, sanitized denial and unavailable-root/authority outcomes, and cleanup on failed issuance. Keep the physical root out of Worker arguments and preserve the existing live-authority and containment design. Reconcile the companion contract and T003/T004 test route, then review a separately pinned corrected boundary.

raw_result.summary: REVISE against the committed pre-correction definition. All seven committed artifact hashes were independently verified, and deterministic plan/task structure validation passed; the defect is semantic testability, not missing ID syntax or task coverage. Prior PR-18.1-LIVE-AUTHORITY remains resolved. The visible working-tree correction appears to supply a concrete Infrastructure issuer, typed result and DB-free public test seam within the previously authorized product scope, but it is outside this pinned verdict and requires separate review.
